Senior Research Associate (table title: Senior Research Fellow (Senior Project Associate))
Candidates with the essential educational qualification, not above 35 years as on 21.11.2026 (relaxation as stated below)

content_sections.heading: About Jharkhand Forest Department
content_sections.text: The Office of the Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Jharkhand, Ranchi is a Government of Jharkhand office under the Department of Forest, Environment & Climate Change, located at Van Bhawan, Doranda, Ranchi. This post is for the Scientific Forestry Management Unit (SFMU) of the Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Jharkhand, Ranchi, a project with a period of 4 years. The notice is signed by P. Rajendra Naidu, IFS, Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, and the office e-mail printed on the letterhead is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one temporary position under the SFMU project. The notice calls it Senior Research Associate in its text and "Senior Research Fellow (Senior Project Associate)" in the post table; it is the same single post. First Class M.Sc in Forestry/ Botany/ Agriculture/ Statistics/ Remote Sensing and Geographical Information Systems (GIS)/ Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Biotechnology. 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average. Those with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree must have UGC/ CSIR/ ICAL/ ICFRE NET qualification or equivalent/ Ph.d in any of the above disciplines. Experience and willingness to work in forest with the forest communities. A good understanding of their respective subjects and its application in forestry sector. Good knowledge in drafting research articles, formal letters, computer operation/ application. 4 year work experience in research and development in their respective fields. Proficiency in computer application, especially MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point), may be an added benefit to the candidate. The candidate should be medically fit to work in different forest areas of the State of Jharkhand. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-wise eligibility for this post. Age, as on the date of interview, i.e. 21.11.2026, should not exceed 35 years. A further relaxation of 4 years in age will be given to SC/ST/OBC/women candidates as per approved rules. The post is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project, with no provision for regularisation. The initial appointment will be for one year or up to the project period (as the case may be). The project period is printed as 4 years. The contract may be terminated even before the completion of the project, and no appeal will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Biodata Passport size photograph Original certificates Attested photocopies of all certificates, mark sheets, degree and testimonials

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reach Palas Sabhagar, Block -B, Van Bhavan, Doranda, Ranchi-834002, and enrol between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Candidates arriving after this time may not ordinarily be entertained. A qualifying test (written) may be conducted before the interview. The interview before the selection committee starts at 11:30 AM. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Jharkhand Forest Department Senior Research Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026, with enrollment from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM and the interview starting at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Office of Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Block -B, Van Bhavan, Doranda, Ranchi-834002 Jharkhand (Palas Sabhagar).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) post of Senior Research Associate under the Scientific Forestry Management Unit (SFMU) project.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A First Class M.Sc in Forestry, Botany, Agriculture, Statistics, Remote Sensing and GIS, Wildlife Science, Zoology or Biotechnology with 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent grade point average. Those with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree must have UGC/ CSIR/ ICAL/ ICFRE NET or equivalent/ Ph.d in these disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age should not exceed 35 years as on 21.11.2026, with a further relaxation of 4 years for SC/ST/OBC/women candidates as per approved rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary, and is HRA paid on top?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 18% HRA, printed as "for 3rd, 4th & 5th Year".

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring your biodata, a passport size photograph, original certificates and attested photocopies of all certificates, mark sheets, degree and testimonials.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: A qualifying test (written) may be conducted before the interview, followed by the interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project, with no provision for regularisation; the initial appointment is for one year or up to the project period.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
